Manuscript, pen-and-ink and pencil. Relief shown by hachures. In this map the name Ohio R. ou la belle rivière is applied also to the Allegheny. The words "direction of" have been inserted in pencil between "By" and "an Indian." "No. 28." Includes notes. On verso: John Montresor. Scale not given. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2: 651/2; 651/4; 700/1
